title: 第十四章：购买别墅
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

在明珠陪着伊万他们玩了几天，这几天的花费全是由虎哥出，算起来虎哥还是很讲义气的，对于伊万他们更的好声好气，把他的视为贵宾。

因为伊万这边还要回去和北极熊复命，虽然这里的危机解除，可是作为军火商，在国内待这么长时间还是心里没个准，北极熊打了个电话，伊万他们就回去了。

“狼，我们回去了，有什么事电话联系”伊万抱了抱苏行枫。

“好吧，你也知道我现在自己一个人干了，可能以后到你们那边的机会很少了，但是我会想念大家的，当然了，我这还有些东西要你帮我准备一下”

说完他从衣服里拿出一张纸，纸上写着密密麻麻的字，这些只有他和伊万他们看得懂。

当伊万拿过一看，他不敢相信自己的眼睛。

“狼，我的兄弟，你这是要打伊拉克吗？你这些东西够一个加强连打一场超强战斗了，我的天啊！坦克都有，这直升机就算你要，我们也很难帮你弄来啊！”

是的，苏行枫想过了，自己打算走出部落，去部落外去看看，听长老说过，自己跟本就走不到城市里，所以他还是要给自己一个保障。

他也想过，让长老带自己去，可是长老死活不愿意：

“大人，你还是要以修炼为主，而不是去沉迷外面的世界，现在你的进步很大，可是那远远还不够啊！！”

没办法，现在只有自己想到这些，至少他还是有最大的保命手段，那就是遇到危险可以随时回地球，但是他也不敢百分百的放心，就好像上回强子他们一样，自己怎么被逮的都不知道。

“兄弟，你自己看着办，我这边时间上给足你们，你们可要帮我准备好，到时候我亲自过来取货”

“好吧，反正这事让熊老大去烦恼去，我想这回他会从将军那想办法了”

告别了他们后，又和虎哥他们打了个招呼，自己回家去了。

当他回去后，发现自己租的房子那开始了全部动工，之前可以在那住一间，可是现在全拆了，没办法，他只能住到酒店中去。自己想想这也不是长久之计啊！

连续在萱姐这帮了几天的忙，自己也算是体会到了萱姐她们这是有多累，他又回到部落，这回他没找长老，而是找到庄平，让他帮自己配了好些药，加了不少的生命水进去。

“萱姐，看看你现在累得，这些是补气调理的营养品，你带回去分点嫂子他们，看着你们这么累我真的是过应不去”

“行枫，你是不知道，姐我看到生意这么好，精神头就上来了，这哪能感觉到累啊！不过是要谢谢你关心。对了，上回你的那个药真的是太好了，你有没有发现姐现在皮肤都好了很多？”

萱姐一副臭美的样子用手摸了摸自己的脸蛋，还让他看。

这不看不要紧，他仔细的把头凑前去看。

“嘿！还真是呢！萱姐，你这不是用了什么好的化妆品吧？”

他用手在萱姐脸上擦了一下，然后抹到自己黑色的T恤上。

“哎呀！干什么呢！女人的脸是可以乱摸的吗？”

刚说完萱姐的脸一下就红了起来，他也一阵感慨连忙道歉。

“呵呵！不好意思，不好意思。萱姐，怎么你没用化妆品，这皮肤也这么好啊！怎么弄的？”

“刚才不是说了吗？是你那个药啊！没想到有这么好，治好了我的手，还让我的皮肤也这么好，现在我整个人都好像年青了许多呢！”

之前看着萱姐有一种黄脸少妇的感觉，不过现在仔细去看的话，整个人的气质都变了，皮肤不说，就连头发发质都更好了，动作也更有活力了。整个人看上去更是漂亮了很多啊！

‘这么说那生命水可以各方面改善啊！那生命水还是稀释了很多的呢！那现在这配的药....等她喝完后！那不是效果更好了啊！’

“萱姐，现在这个药，同样是那老道配的，这可是我花了很大的关系才让那老头帮我配的啊！效果可是要比之前那个更好，你拿回去后给嫂子何大哥带去点。”

They played with Ivan and the others in Mingzhu for a few days, and all the expenses for these days were paid for by Brother Hu. Brother Hu was still very loyal, and he was even more friendly to Ivan and the others, treating him as a distinguished guest.

Because Ivan had to go back and resurrect with the polar bear. Although the crisis here was over, as an arms dealer, he was still unsure about staying in the country for such a long time. The polar bear made a call, and Ivan and the others went back.

"Wolf, we're back. If you need anything, call me." Ivan hugged Su Xingfeng.

"Well, you also know that I am working alone now. There may be few opportunities to come to your place in the future, but I will miss everyone. Of course, I still have some things that I want you to help me prepare."

After saying that, he took out a piece of paper from his clothes, with dense words written on it, which only he and Ivan could understand.

When Ivan took it and took a look, he couldn't believe his eyes.

"Wolf, my brother, are you going to fight in Iraq? These things you have are enough for a reinforced company to fight a super battle. Oh my god! We have tanks. Even if you want this helicopter, it will be difficult for us to get it for you!"

Yes, Su Xingfeng thought about it. He planned to leave the tribe and go outside the tribe to have a look. He heard from the elders that he couldn't walk into the city with Ben, so he still had to give himself a guarantee.

He also thought about asking the elder to take him there, but the elder was unwilling:

"Sir, you still have to focus on cultivation instead of indulging in the outside world. You have made great progress now, but that is far from enough!!"

There is no way, he is the only one who thinks of this now. At least he still has the biggest way to save his life, that is, he can return to Earth at any time if he encounters danger, but he does not dare to be 100% assured. Just like Qiangzi and the others last time, they did not know how they were caught.

"Brother, you can make up your own mind. I'll give you enough time. You have to help me prepare it. I will come to pick up the goods in person when the time comes."

"Well, let Boss Xiong worry about this anyway. I think he will find a solution from the general this time."

After saying goodbye to them, he said hello to Brother Hu and the others and went home.

When he went back, he found that the house he rented was under construction. He could live there before, but now it was completely demolished. He had no choice but to live in a hotel.Think about it yourself, this is not a long-term solution!

After helping Sister Xuan for several days in a row, he finally realized how tired Sister Xuan and the others were. He returned to the tribe again. This time, instead of looking for the elders, he found Zhuang Ping and asked him to help him prepare some medicine and add a lot of life water.

"Sister Xuan, look how tired you are now. These are nutritional supplements for replenishing qi and conditioning. You can take them back and share some with my sister-in-law and the others. Seeing how tired you are, I really can't bear to go."

"

Sister Xuan looked so pretty and touched her face with her hand, and asked him to look at it.

It didn't matter if he didn't look at it, he carefully moved his head forward to take a look.

"Hey! It's true! Sister Xuan, didn't you use some good cosmetics?"

He wiped Sister Xuan's face with his hand, and then wiped it on his black T-shirt.

"Ouch! What are you doing! Is it allowed to touch a woman's face?"

As soon as she finished speaking, Sister Xuan's face turned red, and he felt emotional and quickly apologized.

"Haha! Sorry, sorry. Sister Xuan, why didn't you use cosmetics? Your skin is so good! How did you do it?"

"Didn't I just say that? It's your medicine! I didn't expect it to be so good. It cured my hands and made my skin look so good. Now I feel much younger!"

Looking at Sister Xuan before, I felt like a yellow-faced young woman, but now if I look carefully, my whole temperament has changed. Not to mention her skin, even her hair quality is better, and her movements are more energetic.The whole person looks much more beautiful!

‘So the water of life can be improved in all aspects!The water of life is still diluted a lot!Then wait for the medicine that is prepared now...after she drinks it!Wouldn’t that be better?’

"Sister Xuan, this medicine is also prepared by the old man. I spent a lot of time to get the old man to prepare it for me! The effect is better than the previous one. When you get it back, bring some to your sister-in-law, Brother He."
